rules: same direct successor plus same curator-authored question_key conflicts
same domain alone does not conflict
same successor with a different question_key alone does not conflict

frozen_gates.synthetic_controls: all six controls match their predeclared conflict/non-conflict disposition

decision.uncertain: UNCERTAIN_PROVENANCE if a required GitHub record cannot be mapped without inventing metadata

execution_boundary: The evaluation is deterministic over the frozen GitHub-visible snapshot. Publication of result.json records that evaluation; it is not CI execution and not an atomic GitHub lease transaction.
known_limit: Two sessions can both pass a read-only precheck before either publishes a claim. A PASS here does not close the check-to-claim TOCTOU race.
